Merge PDF

Stitch PDFs together in exactly the order you want.

Combine two or many PDFs into one tidy document. Arrange files before you merge, keep every page intact, and get a single download in seconds.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Merge PDF works

  1. Add two or more PDFs, then drag or use the arrows to set the order.
  2. Check the total page count and press Merge PDF.
  3. Download your combined document. Everything stays on your device.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Organize PDF — Reorder, rotate and remove pages visually.
  • Split PDF — Break one document into the exact pages you need.
